invariants.single_canonical_writer: Only TaskStore may write operational work state; relay/work_graph/github_issue/kanban are derived projections keyed by taskstore_id.
invariants.no_reverse_write: No projection value may be used as a write target; there is no reverse operation from a projection back into canonical work state.
invariants.explicit_uncertainty: A projection whose taskstore_ref does not resolve to a canonical row is reported as unresolved and is never auto-created.
